question: According to WHO, If a person's BMI is below 18.5 he/she is classified as _______.
solution:
**Correct Answer Underweight**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** BMI stands for Body mass index which is the measure of body fat based on the height and weight of men and women.

 
• Increased BMI is usually associated with an increased risk of metabolic diseases such as type II diabetes mellitus, hypertension & dyslipidemia.
 
• BMI is widely used to know whether a person has a healthy weight equivalent to height or not.
